_meta.why_pilot: #228 preregisters 90 sessions at 5 repetitions. This is 1 repetition, frozen and reported as a pilot. A preregistration an executing agent quietly shrinks is not a preregistration, so the reduction is recorded here as its own frozen design rather than presented as the real matrix.
_meta.must_not: A pilot result may never be folded into a promotion estimate, and may never be cited as the qualifying #228 matrix.

arms.no_skill: no Skill text is supplied; the host receives the task alone
arms.current_full_composition: the audit Skill plus the six source Skills it was trimmed from
arms.candidate_trimmed_skill: the audit Skill alone, carrying RCA-001..013

hosts.model_note: verified accepted by this CLI before freezing; three plausible names were rejected with HTTP 400, so the pin is the model this host actually serves rather than one that merely looks right

cost_policy.reason: Codex CLI does not report spend. Scoring two hosts on a quantity only one of them can observe would rank the silent host as the cheaper one. Cost is recorded per cell with cost_observed and excluded from this pilot's acceptance weights.

randomization.arm_order: derived deterministically from sha256(repository_id + host_family) so the order is reproducible and recorded rather than chosen per run

retry_policy.reason: #228 forbids retrying a promotion run unless retry is itself preregistered; it is not, so a failed cell stays in the denominator with its reason.

primary_metric: material_defects_found over material_defects_total, where each task family is a single decidable judgement: did the host cite at least one evidence path that actually exists in the pinned tree
declared_non_claims: one repetition cannot separate an arm effect from run-to-run variance
tool_calls is approximated from the host's own turn count and is not an instrumented tool trace
cost is unobservable on one of the two hosts and is excluded from scoring
no production, cross-repository, or promotion claim follows from this pilot
